title: OpenRouter token usage week of October 5?
description:
This market will resolve according to the total number of tokens processed on OpenRouter for the week of October 5 to October 11, 2026.

The total number of tokens is the weekly total displayed in the Top Models chart on OpenRouter's AI Model Rankings page (https://openrouter.ai/rankings#top-models). OpenRouter's weeks run from 12:00 AM UTC on Monday to 11:59 PM UTC on Sunday, and a week's figures continue to update until the following week's figures are first displayed.

This market will resolve according to the total displayed for the week of October 5 to October 11, 2026 once the figures for the week of October 12, 2026 are first displayed. If the figures for the week of October 12, 2026 have not been displayed by 11:59 PM ET on October 16, 2026, this market will resolve according to the total displayed for the week of October 5 to October 11, 2026 at that time.

This market will resolve based on the total as displayed on the chart, including any rounding applied by OpenRouter. If the displayed total falls exactly on the boundary between two brackets, this market will resolve to the higher bracket.

The resolution source for this market is https://openrouter.ai/rankings.
